description:
## Description

"This remote-controlled passive preamplifier was created with the intention of playing to the end, rather than being half-finished, what the producer had sincerely wished for ""if such a product existed.""It is designed primarily for the purpose of transmitting the line music signal to the main amplifier without degradation.The ATL-1/2preamp of the AIR TIGHT series is used for the m and attenuator, which completely eliminates sound quality degradation, and Acrotec 6N wiring materials are used for different purposes.High-rigidity chassis is adopted, and noise countermeasures are taken by shield processing.The input selector switch is of the earth point simultaneous switching system to prevent mutual interference.Large models are used for the input / output terminals to accommodate large cables.It was possible to incorporate Alps Electric Volume Unit (RK501) as a separately sold option.In this volume, physical properties such as the specific resistance of carbon itself and contact resistance between carbons, as well as audibility characteristics were examined, and a unique high-sound-quality low-distortion carbon resistance material was developed, a newly developed mirror-surface structure resistor substrate was adopted, and a multi-wire brush with a wire brush over the entire width of the resistor pattern was adopted to realize high-quality reproduction.In addition, in order to realize an ideal characteristic in which the volume rises smoothly, the specific resistance is 5x10.4A resistor ink of � Ï‰ cm has been developed to smooth the rising characteristic from the high-frequency attenuation position.In addition, in order to eliminate the effect of vibration, vibration is eliminated thoroughly from the use of a ¥8brass shaft, vibration control of the shaft and bearing, increased holding strength of the resistor substrate, brush fixing method, and review of fixing screws."

name: Air
description:
## Description

"In commemoration of the 15th anniversary of A &ΩM, this is the first model of the 21st century, a bulb-tube type monaural power amplifier.The ATM 211was planned as the second series of the Single-Ended Triode Amp following the ATM 300b. A direct-heating triode tube 211, which has been used as a transmission tube at broadcasting stations, is used at the output stage.The output stage is non-feedback (0db), and the vacuum tube drive amplifier style of all 3-pole tube configuration is adopted in order to pursue the sound of the direct-heating 3-pole tube 211.Class A operation is adopted.Output tube cathode follower High power is pursued by direct drive.Heater hum is removed by DC ignition of 211filament.The output tube electrolytic capacitor is protected by a muting circuit that employs a relay to extend the life.The power supply section uses a power transformer with separate windings for each circuit of the amplifier stage / bias / heater / relay to reduce mutual interference.Wide-band tamura large transformer is adopted.By adopting a bias check circuit, the operation status of the output tube can be confirmed."

## Description

"This is a bulb-tube type stereo power amplifier designed using reliable parts along with the progress of modern electronics while taking full advantage of the characteristics of vacuum tubes.The circuit structure is NFB by Mulard type phase inversion and UL connection. It is based on the reliable orthodox circuit which demonstrates the advantage of 6CA7, and the circuit which causes distrust in unstable long-term use is eliminated as much as possible.A rectifier tube is used to protect the power tube from the rush current when the AC power is turned on, while maintaining the sound quality of the vacuum tube.In addition, 5AR4is connected in parallel so that it can withstand large currents.Printed circuit boards, which affect sound, are eliminated, and all of them are hooked up to terminals for manual wiring.The CD direct connection terminal is mounted on the front panel.This terminal can be directly connected to the first stage tube."

name: Air
description:
## Description

"A vacuum tube power amplifier announced as the second A &ΩM power amplifier.KT-88has been adopted for the output tube, and it has been designed to bring out the full power of KT-88and aim at the latest for the present day.The driver stage uses a cathode follower circuit using 12BH7A.12BH7A with large plate loss supplies a strong drive voltage with low output impedance and no waveform distortion to the power tube.In addition, it is directly connected to the power tube, and a stable drive without transient distortion is realized by eliminating the condenser.A meter for adjusting the output tube bias current and a selector switch are mounted on the front panel.This allows the optimum operating point of the output tube to be checked and the semi-fixed VR can be easily adjusted from the top of the chassis in case of bias deviation.High sound quality is achieved by 1.1point manual wiring without using a printed circuit board.Tamura'Ωs highest-grade transformer is used for the output transformer.With transformer technology that meets the standards of the Defense Agency, tamura Manufacturing has a high track record for broadcasting stations. The transformer adopted is a large type with input resistance of more than 100W. Moreover, the constant loss is as low as 0.25dB. In addition, by adopting a special oriented core for the core of the transformer, there is no gap over entire band.Parts are not only good in sound quality, but also highly reliable parts that can withstand long-term use. We select parts that can maintain initial performance regardless of the environment under which they are used.All of the semi-fixed VRs are wound type large (30�) enclosed type, while the 8P socket is made of Lux, the 9P socket is made of Cinch, and the 9P first stage tube is made of tight gold plating. These are highly reliable parts.The front input can be directly connected to the first stage tube without passing through a shield wire.It can be used in the same way as a normal input terminal and can be played back without losing the sound quality of CDs.By using the front attenuator, you can play without connecting a preamplifier."

name: Air
description:
## Description

"A bulb-type stereo power amplifier using a beam tube 6L6-WGC.The 6L6-GC has a long history. It was introduced as a military metal tube from its predecessor, RCA in 1936. Since then, there have been many variations such as 6L6-G and 6L6-GB, and it has been changed to 6L6-GC. The ATM-4was developed when a very high-quality 6L6-GC was available from Russia.UL connection is adopted, and the unique sound of 6L6is drawn out by lowering internal impedance and operating without lowering power.To obtain even higher power, a stereo / monaural switch is installed so that it can be used as a monaural power amplifier.Gain is obtained by using 12AT7with low internal resistance for high mu and high Gm for the first stage.The NFB is set to a little less than 10dB, and by minimizing for low distortion by minimizing the phase correction.We use hand wiring that does not use any boards, and we use different wiring materials at important points for careful wiring.Equipped with balance check circuit.The balance of the output tube push-pull operation can be adjusted to the optimum condition by the center meter located in the center of the panel and the adjustment volume in the ceiling panel.Highly reliable parts such as metal film resistance, detent type volume, large winding volume, etc. are carefully selected for use.It is designed with attention to details such as large and thick aluminum panel, solid wood carving knob, and chassis paint that has been repeatedly painted."

name: Air
description:
## Description

"This tube type equalizer amplifier was developed as an anniversary model for A &ΩM, which celebrated its 10th anniversary.The equalizer circuit uses a 2-stage NF method and the output stage uses a low-impedance, high-output SRPP circuit. The NF circuit is stably driven over a wide band for low distortion factor.It is equipped with a flat amplifier so that it can output stably with low impedance even when the attenuator is used.A single-stage SRPP circuit is used for the circuit configuration, and as it is sent out with low output impedance like a normal preamplifier, all power amplifiers can be driven regardless of vacuum tube or transistor type.In addition, the Line input terminal is mounted so that the CD input can be switched in the same way as other preamplifiers.The power supply section uses a rectifier tube that operates faster than a silicon diode and does not generate pulse noise. It has a low-noise design in which it is supplied to each amplifier stage through a semiconductor filter, a regulator circuit with a vacuum tube, and a large-capacity capacitor bank.For signal lines, we have adopted manual wiring that does not use any boards.Each lead wire is carefully wired one by one. For example, the best possible wiring material, copper wire, is used at every point, and the ground circuit is switched for each input.The chassis is made of 1.6mm thick iron plate, which is also used for heavy main amplifiers.In addition, copper plating is used depending on the amplification part to suppress vibration and at the same time to make it nonmagnetic.High-quality parts are used both in Japan and overseas to ensure high reliability.It uses a new type of high-quality and high-precision volume.We have developed and adopted a new material, carbon resistance, a brass machined structure that is resistant to vibration, and a gold-plated multi-contact wire brush that is not only good in sound quality and accuracy but also good in operation feeling.It has an equalizer direct output jack so that it can output directly from the equalizer without passing through an attenuator."
